snippet.title: Jump Space Joyride - Demo Available!
snippet.description:
We have a free, private demo available for Jump Space Joyride!

If you'd like to play, join the Chaos Theory Discord: 
https://discord.gg/hrtSM5yKsn

Find out more about the game on itch.io:
https://chaostheorygames.itch.io/jump-space-joyride

A 1-4 player co-op heist game where you steal an alien spaceship, escape your pursuers, and loot everything that isn't bolted down. The controls are in alien. Good luck!

📰 Follow development:
LinkTree (all socials): https://linktr.ee/chaostheorygames
Studio: https://chaostheorygames.com

#indiegame #friendslop #coopgaming #simulation #madewithunity
